summary: The original source denominator remains 19 findings: 14 internal and five external. #833 review evidence is merged by PR #853 and adds six review observations that the final ledger must disposition separately. #851 was superseded by v0.92.2 issue #852. #856 / PR #858 remains the release-version and native-v3 preflight blocker.
